09/06 — one egg yolk - slightly beaten

dear revolutionists and communaries,

pocohontas reporting in here from the darkest corners of desire. i'm here to guide you, make things a bit clearer. if your loins burn and itch with fiery passion, and you wanna purchase 'the picardy third e.p.' you have two reasonable options. number one, click over to our lovely parent corporation paribus records and follow your instincts in their webstore. your second option; tell me nothing is physical, real, or even believable and spend your money on dreams at the itunes music store. while you are at it, pray for peace, but you don't get any packaging with that option.

we gonna bust a local show this friday at subterranean, and then you will be able to catch us next at cmj in new york.

vern! what the heck are those hoodlums doing with all that darn free time??

love, charlie deets and the tender loins

08/18 — i stormed; paraded with fists.

we ate too many cookies. we had too much dessert. we kissed too many tongues. now we gotta polish our rudiments and make a real record. we will be residing in our new urban dungeon, where we have set up a spectacular light display to keep us 'in the mood.' if you want to contact us, whisper our name in the middle of the night. focus on your ceiling, and let go of your worldly troubles. elsewise, look out on the gigaweb, we might pull a trick or two to show you what stew we've been cooking.

08/21 — pretty girls don't drive cars

we sure did peek our strong-head out from underneath the couch. it's bright out there and you all talk too much. so we went back inside. and now we are finishing up another e.p. if you could make babies this quick, cane sugar wouldn't be so easy-breezy. don't be afraid to look around for secrets around here. don't be afraid to make your very own custom secrets as well. and come visit us here.

entry & source

07/29 — the german built the love machine.

partake, berate. from the splendor tree of dissonance, the wretched crow spews terrible news. the attrition e.p. is a consumable good. the price is five-gali pence. you desire and retire by walking over to our new and improved sally-mart. if you do it correctly, it will be shipped by the united states postal service to you on august eleventh, in the year of our bored two-thousand-five. oh fear the coming winter by picking up a storm cloud enhanced cloak while you are in town.

speaking of your town, we might very well be in it, broken footed and paranoid. sally, the collective, is riding the oregon trail in a carriage called 'the elbow, and secret societies tour.' check our two-our section for explicit details.

and alas alak, the worst of the despicable horrors. on august eleventh two-thousand-five, our backbone and medical man hunter morris will play his finale with us. as he has been extradited to our fatherland and home country. no more will he speak the wonders of wiki-knowledge. celebrate his independence as well as our record release as well as our homecoming (we bring riddles from lands beyond) on august eleventh. check the war-plans for all the important logistics.

whilst you adore the unadorable, take a look around. we live in a temporary autonomous zone and we wanted to share it with you. find spectacular secrets in hidden corners. with that i must return my dagger to my pocket and open my trusty bottle of terror-noise, and take a strong redolent whif

entry & source

05/19 — loves' still in the oven.

apparently, in life, when you think you settle, everything becomes upset, until you unsettle yourself. tally-ho.

we are soonly embarking on 'the elbows and secret societies tour." we could very well be coming empty handed to a town near you, incoherently babbling about why we mean something.

karsten, the german undertaker is currently chopping up babies and figuring out the best way to blow them up (tastefully). til he is done, here are some extra links you might find useful.

buy.
kill.
waste.
manure.

entry & source

04/03 — the love box ain't ready yet.

a crazy chain-smoking german contacted us from an underground bunker in berlin. he is putting this and that together to make this and that. it takes time to make this and that.

we sat in an above ground bunker for far too long and created something that is far too short to believe. our four song extended play disc is done, the title remains the same : the attrition e.p. i can't let you in on all the secrets, but you can see a little film we made in 1969, shot on super 8mm in the dry-docks of nebraska. if you need assisted internetting, you can vidi a low-fi version here.

if you find your way up to the irritable crow, he will maybe play you a song or two that you can't even pay a soul to buy yet. he's a nice crow, the german named karsten brought him to us from a crow farm. he's a nice german.

we are the rubberband band. wait til you see the dubious amount of shows you can see us play in the next months. and we might even travel a bit around the country in the summer solstice. keep that in mind for your summer plans, you non-midwest sinners.

the last paragraph contained questionable use of the word dubious. but as you can see, according to merriam-webster, my official source of linguistics, dubious means : "b : questionable or suspect as to true nature or quality." touche.

back to the noise machine. keep your heads on straight.

  • Date conflict retained: July 23, 2006 is listed for both Reversible Eye Gallery in Chicago and Velvet Lounge in Washington, D.C. The archive does not resolve this apparent conflict; neither date has been silently changed.

  • Non-show placeholder excluded from the gigography: the page's playful “Mars” header changes from September 9, 2009 to December 21, 2012 between snapshots.
